title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Premium Revision Paper #18

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #18
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which surah is the last surah of the Qur'an? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Falaq
   B. Al-Ikhlas
   C. An-Naas
   D. Al-Fatiha

2. Which food is worst for teeth if we do not brush after? (1 mark)
   A. Sweets and sugary drinks
   B. Cabbage
   C. Water
   D. Plain rice

3. A game is permitted in Islam if (1 mark)
   A. It is safe, fair and does not stop us from prayer
   B. It hurts people
   C. It involves betting
   D. It uses bad words

4. Which of these is a benefit of exercise? (1 mark)
   A. Stronger muscles and a healthy heart
   B. Less sleep
   C. Weak bones
   D. More diseases

5. What is a good weekly fitness plan for a child? (1 mark)
   A. Sitting all day
   B. About 20 minutes of activity daily and water instead of soda
   C. No sleep
   D. Only sweets

6. What should you do when the adhan is called during a game? (1 mark)
   A. Ask for extra time
   B. Turn off the radio
   C. Continue the game
   D. Stop, make wudhu and pray

7. What is a good manner of making dua? (1 mark)
   A. Never ask
   B. Ask only for toys
   C. Shout
   D. Begin with praise and end with Amin

8. Ar-Rahman's mercy is (1 mark)
   A. Only for Muslims in Kenya
   B. For all creation
   C. Only for adults
   D. Only for the rich

9. Which duty belongs to Jibril? (1 mark)
   A. Recording deeds
   B. Taking souls
   C. Blowing the Trumpet
   D. Bringing revelation

10. What is obedience? (1 mark)
   A. Doing what Allah and rightful authority command in what is good
   B. Ignoring orders
   C. Running away
   D. Arguing

11. Which prophet is linked with honesty and truthfulness in hard times, including prison? (1 mark)
   A. Lut
   B. Yusuf
   C. Ayyub
   D. Hud

12. What is patience? (1 mark)
   A. Staying calm and trusting Allah in hardship
   B. Complaining
   C. Getting angry
   D. Giving up

13. How many types of najasaat are taught in this lesson? (1 mark)
   A. Seven
   B. Two
   C. Three
   D. Five

14. What is a mutawassitah najasa? (1 mark)
   A. A heavy najasa
   B. A drink
   C. A light najasa
   D. A medium najasa

15. What does "najasa" mean? (1 mark)
   A. A food
   B. A journey
   C. A prayer
   D. An impurity

16. Which is physical purity? (1 mark)
   A. Washing off urine from clothes
   B. Giving charity
   C. Removing envy from the heart
   D. Saying sorry

17. If you stretch your right arm toward the sunrise, you are facing roughly (1 mark)
   A. South
   B. North
   C. West
   D. East

18. Which of these can help find the Qibla? (1 mark)
   A. The size of the mosque
   B. A compass or Qibla app
   C. The noise from the road
   D. The colour of the sky

19. Which surah is recited in every rak'ah? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Fatiha
   B. Al-Masad
   C. Al-Kafirun
   D. An-Nasr

20. What did the Prophet tell the man who prayed in a hurry? (1 mark)
   A. Pray faster
   B. Ignore it
   C. Continue
   D. Go back and pray again

21. What is tartib? (1 mark)
   A. Praying without wudhu
   B. Doing the pillars in order
   C. Making dua
   D. Praying fast

22. Why do animals give us benefit? (1 mark)
   A. They give us food, milk, work and transport
   B. They are useless
   C. They cannot help
   D. They only eat

23. In the Prophet's story, a woman was punished because she (1 mark)
   A. Fed a cat
   B. Starved a cat she had tied up
   C. Gave a cat milk
   D. Adopted a cat

24. Which is a dressing trend to avoid? (1 mark)
   A. Neat trousers
   B. Clean uniform
   C. Simple kanzu
   D. Clothes worn to show off

25. Which of these is internet media? (1 mark)
   A. A video website
   B. A newspaper
   C. A poster
   D. A book

26. What should come before screen time? (1 mark)
   A. Nothing
   B. Prayer, homework and helping at home
   C. Videos
   D. Games

27. What should you do if a stranger online asks for your address? (1 mark)
   A. Tell friends
   B. Refuse and tell an adult
   C. Give it
   D. Send a photo

28. Which is a positive use of media? (1 mark)
   A. Sharing rumours
   B. Learning a surah with a recording
   C. Watching harmful content
   D. Bullying online

29. Which is a way a child can earn safely with permission? (1 mark)
   A. Doing chores for a small reward
   B. Taking loans
   C. Begging on the road
   D. Stealing

30. Which of these is a skill that can bring honest income later? (1 mark)
   A. Cheating
   B. Lying
   C. Tailoring
   D. Stealing

31. What do we say when entering the house? (1 mark)
   A. Tawakkaltu 'alallah
   B. Only Amin
   C. Subhanallah
   D. Bismillahi walajna, wa bismillahi kharajna, wa 'ala Rabbina tawakkalna

32. Who is a shepherd responsible for his flock according to the hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Only kings
   B. Only traders
   C. Every person responsible for those in his care
   D. Only teachers

33. Which is an obligation of parents? (1 mark)
   A. Making them work all day
   B. Neglecting health
   C. Ignoring children
   D. Providing food, clothing and shelter

34. What does "uff" mean in Qur'an 17:23? (1 mark)
   A. A song
   B. A prayer
   C. A word of impatience
   D. A greeting

35. Which shows disobedience? (1 mark)
   A. Helping with dishes
   B. Speaking softly
   C. Slamming doors and refusing to help
   D. Greeting parents

36. Which family event should we attend to keep ties? (1 mark)
   A. Only sad events
   B. Nothing
   C. Only cartoons
   D. A wedding or naming ceremony

37. What is silat ar-rahm? (1 mark)
   A. Praying
   B. Keeping family ties
   C. Trading
   D. Fasting

38. What is the Night of the first revelation often connected with? (1 mark)
   A. Mawlid
   B. Eid
   C. Hajj
   D. Laylat al-Qadr

39. Who was the first person to believe in the Prophet's message? (1 mark)
   A. Ali
   B. Abu Bakr
   C. Khadija
   D. Bilal

40. Apart from Ibrahim, whose children were all the Prophet's children? (1 mark)
   A. Khadija's
   B. Safiyya's
   C. Hafsa's
   D. Aisha's

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Name the three types of najasaat. (3 marks)

42. Give three character traits of the Prophet (S.A.W.) and one way to practise each. (3 marks)

43. How does the name Al-Malik help us to use our belongings wisely? (3 marks)

44. Explain what "Al-Fatiha" means and why it has that name. (3 marks)

45. Write the hadith on physical fitness given in your syllabus. (2 marks)

46. Give three effects of belief in angels on a Muslim's life. (3 marks)

47. Describe how a Grade 4 child can practise honesty, generosity, patience and obedience. (4 marks)

48. What lesson do we learn from Surah Al-Masad? (3 marks)

49. Write the meaning of the dua for entering the house. (3 marks)

50. State three rules for using working animals safely. (3 marks)

51. Describe how Ali (R.A.) accepted Islam and what he did as a young man. (3 marks)

52. Name three types of Muslim clothing worn in Kenya. (3 marks)

53. What does twahara mean and why is it important? (2 marks)

54. Match each surah with one lesson: Al-Fatiha, Al-Kafirun, An-Nasr and Al-Ikhlas. (4 marks)

55. Explain how a Grade 4 child can apply the command "Iqra". (4 marks)

56. Suggest three ways to keep in touch with relatives who live far away. (3 marks)

57. Describe what you should do when you enter your home. (4 marks)

58. Explain how brushing teeth can be an act of ibadah. (4 marks)

59. Name the five daily prayers in order and give the rak'ahs of any two. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #18 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — An-Naas
   An-Naas is number 114, the last surah.

2. A — Sweets and sugary drinks
   Sugar feeds germs.

3. A — It is safe, fair and does not stop us from prayer
   These are the conditions.

4. A — Stronger muscles and a healthy heart
   Exercise strengthens the body.

5. B — About 20 minutes of activity daily and water instead of soda
   Regular activity keeps fit.

6. D — Stop, make wudhu and pray
   Prayer must not be delayed by play.

7. D — Begin with praise and end with Amin
   Dua begins with praise.

8. B — For all creation
   It covers believers and non-believers, people and animals.

9. D — Bringing revelation
   He delivered the Qur'an.

10. A — Doing what Allah and rightful authority command in what is good
   Obedience is following good commands.

11. B — Yusuf
   The Qur'an calls Yusuf "Siddiq".

12. A — Staying calm and trusting Allah in hardship
   Patience is steady calm.

13. C — Three
   Light, medium and heavy.

14. D — A medium najasa
   Mutawassitah means medium.

15. D — An impurity
   Najasaat are impure things.

16. A — Washing off urine from clothes
   Physical purity concerns body, clothes and place.

17. B — North
   Right arm east means facing north.

18. B — A compass or Qibla app
   A compass helps find north.

19. A — Al-Fatiha
   It is a pillar.

20. D — Go back and pray again
   He did not pray properly.

21. B — Doing the pillars in order
   It means order.

22. A — They give us food, milk, work and transport
   Animals serve people.

23. B — Starved a cat she had tied up
   She did not feed it or let it find food.

24. D — Clothes worn to show off
   Showing off is disliked.

25. A — A video website
   The internet carries websites and videos.

26. B — Prayer, homework and helping at home
   Priorities first.

27. B — Refuse and tell an adult
   Strangers can be unsafe.

28. B — Learning a surah with a recording
   Media can teach.

29. A — Doing chores for a small reward
   With parents' permission.

30. C — Tailoring
   Tailoring is a skill.

31. D — Bismillahi walajna, wa bismillahi kharajna, wa 'ala Rabbina tawakkalna
   This is the dua for entering.

32. C — Every person responsible for those in his care
   Recorded by Al-Bukhari and Muslim.

33. D — Providing food, clothing and shelter
   Basic needs.

34. C — A word of impatience
   Do not say even "uff".

35. C — Slamming doors and refusing to help
   Rudeness is wrong.

36. D — A wedding or naming ceremony
   Attending strengthens ties.

37. B — Keeping family ties
   Ties of kinship.

38. D — Laylat al-Qadr
   Surah 97 speaks about it.

39. C — Khadija
   Khadija was first.

40. A — Khadija's
   All his children except Ibrahim were from Khadija.

SECTION B
----
41. (3 marks)
   Answer: Mukhaffafah (light), mutawassitah (medium) and mughalladha (heavy).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Trustworthy: return borrowed items. Truthful: tell the truth about mistakes. Kind: share your lunch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each trait with a suitable way.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Everything belongs to Allah, so we should use what we have responsibly, share and be thankful.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Allah as Owner, 1 mark for responsible use, 1 mark for sharing or gratitude.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Al-Fatiha means The Opening. It is the first surah of the Qur'an and it opens every prayer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for first surah, 1 mark for opening the prayer.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: Teach your children swimming, archery and horse riding.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the skills and 1 mark for the instruction to teach children.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: More honesty, more thankfulness, respect for the Qur'an, remembering death and the Day of Judgement.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid effect.

47. (4 marks)
   Answer: Honesty: return lost items; generosity: share lunch; patience: wait calmly for a turn; obedience: come when parents call.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each virtue with a suitable action.

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wealth and family connections cannot save a person who refuses the truth and harms good people. We should avoid pride and harm.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for wealth cannot save, 1 mark for harming others is wrong, 1 mark for avoiding pride.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we depend.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the three parts.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: Do not overload, give water and rest, do not beat, keep them healthy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule.

51. (3 marks)
   Answer: He saw the Prophet and Khadija praying, asked, and accepted Islam. He was loyal and brave and slept in the Prophet's bed on the night of the migration.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the points.

52. (3 marks)
   Answer: Kanzu, kofia, hijab or headscarf, buibui, long dress.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

53. (2 marks)
   Answer: Twahara means purity. It is a condition for prayer and other acts of worship.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning and 1 mark for importance.

54. (4 marks)
   Answer: Al-Fatiha: praise Allah and ask for guidance; Al-Kafirun: stay firm in faith; An-Nasr: thank Allah when you succeed; Al-Ikhlas: Allah is One.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct pair.

55. (4 marks)
   Answer: Read and study daily, ask teachers questions, use safe sources to learn, share knowledge with others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four ways.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: Call, send messages, send gifts, visit in holidays, attend family events.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

57. (4 marks)
   Answer: Say Bismillah and the dua, greet with salaam, place shoes neatly, wash hands, speak kindly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four actions.

58. (4 marks)
   Answer: Brush with the intention of following the Sunnah, and to keep clean for prayer. Allah rewards good intentions. We keep the body pure and please Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for intention, 1 mark for following the Sunnah, 1 mark for keeping clean for prayer, 1 mark for reward.

59. (3 marks)
   Answer: Fajr (2), Dhuhr (4), Asr (4), Maghrib (3), Isha (4). Any two with correct rak'ahs.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for names in order and 2 marks for two rak'ahs.
